name: Trump Organization

summary.text: The Trump Organization is the privately held real-estate and licensing business of the Trump family; Eric Trump is its executive vice president. In 2024-26 it announced a series of branded projects in the Gulf with the Saudi-backed developer Dar Global: Trump Tower Jeddah (December 2024), Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai (April 30, 2025), Trump International Golf Club and villas at Simaisma in Qatar with Qatari Diar, a subsidiary of the Qatar Investment Authority (April 30, 2025), Trump Plaza Jeddah (September 2025) and a golf project in Diriyah, Riyadh (January 2026). Separately, in May 2025 the Pentagon accepted a Boeing 747-8 from the government of Qatar for modification as a presidential aircraft, which Democratic members of Congress challenged under the Foreign Emoluments Clause, and the White House published fact sheets on investment pledges from Saudi Arabia, Qatar and the UAE during the president's May 2025 trip.

facts.claim: On April 30, 2025, Qatari Diar and Dar Global signed an agreement at Qatari Diar's headquarters in Lusail to develop Trump International Golf Club and Trump-branded villas within the Simaisma master plan, 40 kilometres north of Doha, with an 18-hole course and clubhouse on about 790,000 square metres. Qatari Diar's website states it was established in 2005 by the Qatar Investment Authority. Qatari Diar's CEO Ali Mohamed Al-Ali said the partnership was expected to bring about $2 billion in foreign investment into Qatar.
facts.quote: The project is part of the landmark Simaisma coastal project located 40 kilometres north of Doha.

facts.claim: Eric Trump, executive vice president of the Trump Organization, said of the Qatar agreement: 'We are incredibly proud to expand the Trump brand into Qatar through this exceptional collaboration with Qatari Diar and Dar Global.'
facts.quote: We are incredibly proud to expand the Trump brand into Qatar through this exceptional collaboration with Qatari Diar and Dar Global. Trump International Golf Club Simaisma and our luxury villa community will reflect our highest standards of quality, prestige, and timeless elegance.

facts.claim: On April 30, 2025, Dar Global and the Trump Organization announced the launch of Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai, an 80-floor, 350-metre tower on Sheikh Zayed Road at the entrance of Downtown Dubai, described as the fifth collaboration between the two companies. Dar Global had first announced a Trump tower in Dubai in July 2024.
facts.quote: It is the Middle East's first and only Trump International Hotel & Tower and the fifth collaboration between DarGlobal and the Trump Organisation.

facts.claim: In Saudi Arabia, the Trump Organization and Dar Global launched Trump Tower Jeddah, a 47-storey residential tower on the Jeddah Corniche, in December 2024, with completion planned for December 2029; announced Trump Plaza Jeddah, a mixed-use project within the Amaya development on King Abdulaziz Road, in September 2025; and in January 2026 announced a Trump International Golf Club in Wadi Safar within the Diriyah master plan near Riyadh, on a site of 2.6 million square metres. Reuters, cited by The National, put the combined value of the Diriyah and Jeddah projects at $10 billion.
facts.quote: Spread across 2.6 million square metres will be the Trump International Golf Club in Wadi Safar, the master plan being developed by Diriyah Company.

facts.claim: On May 21, 2025, Pentagon spokesman Sean Parnell announced that Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth had accepted a Boeing 747 from Qatar, stating: 'The Secretary of Defense has accepted a Boeing 747 from Qatar in accordance with all federal rules and regulations.' The Air Force said it was preparing to award a contract to convert the 747-8 into a presidential transport and that the contract details were classified. The aircraft was valued in reporting at about $400 million.
facts.quote: The Secretary of Defense has accepted a Boeing 747 from Qatar in accordance with all federal rules and regulations.

facts.claim: The Air Force's first public statement on the Qatari 747-8 said the aircraft was being modified for 'Executive Airlift support' and that contract details were classified, declining to name the contractor or scope of work. In January 2026 the Air Force said it anticipated delivery of the 'VC-25 bridge aircraft' no later than summer 2026, and in May 2026 it said the jet had completed modification and flight testing and that L3Harris Technologies had been selected to modify it in collaboration with Boeing. Air Force Secretary Troy Meink said the retrofit would probably cost less than $400 million; critics in Congress said the cost would approach $1 billion.
facts.quote: The Air Force remains committed to expediting delivery of the VC-25 bridge aircraft in support of the Presidential airlift mission, with an anticipated delivery no later than summer 2026.

facts.claim: Democratic members of Congress challenged the Qatari aircraft as a foreign emolument. On May 14, 2025 Senate Judiciary ranking member Dick Durbin asked Attorney General Pam Bondi for the Justice Department memo reportedly finding the gift 'legally permissible'; on May 15, 2025 Rep. Jamie Raskin and other House Judiciary Democrats wrote to Bondi and White House Counsel David Warrington; Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer placed a hold on Justice Department nominees; and S.Res.244 would declare acceptance of the plane without Congress's consent an illegal emolument. These are allegations and requests by members of Congress, not findings.
facts.quote: affirming that the underlying purpose of the Foreign Emoluments Clause renders the acceptance and transfer of a plane from the Government of Qatar, without the explicit consent of Congress, an illegal emolument

facts.claim: During the president's May 2025 trip to the Gulf, the White House published fact sheets stating that Saudi Arabia had committed to invest $600 billion in the United States (May 13), that the president had signed an agreement with Qatar to generate an economic exchange worth at least $1.2 trillion, including deals totalling more than $243.5 billion (May 14), and that the UAE had agreed to more than $200 billion in new deals while accelerating a previously committed $1.4 trillion investment (May 15). The figures are the administration's announced headline values.
facts.quote: The May 15 announcement covered over $200 billion in commercial deals, bringing total investment agreements in the Gulf region to over $2 trillion.

openQuestions: The Trump Organization's own release on the Qatar project names only Dar Global as its partner, while Qatari Diar's release names both Qatari Diar and Dar Global; the contractual relationship between the Trump Organization and Qatari Diar (licensing vs. direct agreement) should be checked in the releases themselves.

No source reached states a direct relationship between the Trump Organization and Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund; Dar Global's ownership (reported as a London-listed arm of Dar Al Arkan) was not verified and no PIF connection is recorded.

The task referred to an Air Force statement in July 2025; the Air & Space Forces Magazine article recording the 'Executive Airlift support' statement is undated in the search result, so the item carries the 2026 statements' dates. The owner should confirm the July 2025 date on the page.
Whether the Justice Department memo on the aircraft was released to Congress, and whether the plane was transferred to the presidential library foundation as reported, were not confirmed.
Dollar values for the Qatar project ($3 billion, Siasat) and the Saudi projects ($10 billion, Reuters via The National) come from press reports, not the companies.
